notes: Complete independent second reading of scan100 only: whole page once, native overlapping halves once each, all agreed and disagreed tokens, 40 existing comparisons, 20 assigned marks, four supplementary decisions, nine previous doubts, seven certainty decisions, and all 12 inventory elements checked.

The author judges the earlier conjectural conditions too platonic and describes approaching a plausible conjecture via the written MD moduli and Teichmüller-name passage. The list then restates lacet and étale-cover stability conditions for a groupoid automorphism to arise from Gamma. These are manuscript assertions, not established mathematical results in this audit.
The two changes are local diacritics: an explicitly doubtful joined u-mark in the proper name, and plain i in the baseline groupoide. The separately crossed marginal noun is not changed by analogy.

Correction of preliminary audit communication: I initially claimed the comma after algébriques had been omitted from the consolidated page. Direct comparison of the literal packet consolidated.tex and its saved raw text shows that the comma was already present. The source comma is confirmed unchanged. No comma replacement or witness-error count belongs to this audit.

The five mislocated historical trial crops for sont, inserted me, conjecture/intéressante, internes and pense surtout were not used as evidence. The current reading uses si_on_veut, cancelled_parait, root_conjecture_transition, root_internes_actual and root_pense_surtout_actual at their actual recorded boxes. The correct transition crop also supports the preceding me rapprocher du point où phrase.
No additional deletion, insertion, page number, drawing or diagram was found. The sole archive folio is the thin lighter 99 at lower left; no author number appears.

All nine previous doubts are retained explicitly, including the consequential bar/no-bar distinction in the inserted intersection formula. No field, grammatical agreement, abbreviation or mathematical assertion was regularized.

No theorem was independently proved, re-proved, computed or rechecked in this audit. The existing root event 142-100-B1 remains a prior carried-background observation; it is not relabelled as a new audit proof event. check_events is empty.
